name: rosetta-lyndon-word
code:
use default

lyndon_words(alphabet: string, n: int) -> Pipe[string] is
    let last = alphabet.length - 1
    let word = LIST([-1])

    while word.count > 0 do
        word[word.count - 1] = word[word.count - 1] + 1

        yield word |> map(i => alphabet[i]) |> join("")

        let period = word.count

        while word.count < n do
            word.add(word[word.count - period])
        od

        while word.count > 0 /\ word[word.count - 1] == last do
            word.remove_at(word.count - 1)
        od
    od
si

write_line(lyndon_words("01", 5) |> join(", "))
write_line(lyndon_words("012", 3) |> join(", "))
